data.title: 爱宕 · 沙发上的沉溺大姐姐怀抱
data.description: 昏暗温暖的客厅沙发里，围裙衣领半解的爱宕将你紧紧搂入饱满怀中。黑色犬耳因情动泛起粉红，她在你耳边发出甜腻轻喘，用几乎能融化灵魂的力道将你拥抱入深渊。
data.location: cozy private living room couch by lamplight
data.action: sitting on sofa pulling partner head into generous bust, apron untied, soft moaning whisper at ear, dog ears flushed pink, eyes filled with overwhelming motherly desire
data.lighting: intimate warm ambient floor lamp casting amber shadows
data.mood: smothering pampering affection, overwhelming sensual security, heated romance
data.promptProse: Embracing partner tightly on a dim couch, Atago pulls partner head into her chest with flushed cheeks and breathless whispers of devotion.
data.animaCaption: Atago pulling partner into a deep pampering embrace on a living room couch.
